name: Pioneer Trails Day Camp
operator_name: West Essex YMCA (Metropolitan YMCA of the Oranges)
description_short: West Essex YMCA day camp on the Caldwell University campus for children entering kindergarten through 8th grade. Campers swim daily and rotate through arts and crafts, archery, performing arts, STEAM, a maker space and sports, choose weekly clubs, and alternate field trips with on site special events.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund if cancelled by April 1, 2027; from April 2 all payments, including deposits, are forfeited. Changes cost $35 from February 1 when made through the Welcome Center, and for all requests from April 2.
notes: Posted rates: Community (non-member) $802 ($761 early bird); Y member $729 ($693 early bird); Y family membership $656. The page does not say these are weekly, though the Y's 2027 policy bills camp by the week. Camp 9 to 4; before care 7:30 to 9 included, after care 4 to 6 and busing from Livingston, West Orange and the Caldwells cost extra. Bring lunch (or order from Simply Gourmet); pizza provided Fridays. Y for All financial assistance. The West Essex Y also runs Summer Sprouts (pre K), Super Summer and Teen Adventure camps.

changes: No fees recorded. After care (4 to 6 pm) and busing are 'available for an additional fee', but neither the Pioneer Trails page nor the 2027 policy prints an amount. Membership is optional (it only lowers the rate) and the 15% down payment goes toward tuition.
for_andrew: The Pioneer Trails page prints no year on its dates or rates. The dates (June 21 to August 13) match the Y's 2027 policy, so I used 2027. The rates ($802 community, $729 member) carry no unit; I took them as weekly because the policy bills camp by the week, but the page's 15% down payment of $145 to $160 does not fit that. Please confirm before publishing.
